verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents first-party ingestion paths: Data Transfer Service scheduled load jobs, near-real-time replication from databases, Pub/Sub BigQuery subscriptions for streaming, and Dataform for the transformation step of ELT. However, the pack never lists which SaaS apps or databases are covered, shows no partner or ETL/ELT-vendor connector ecosystem, and gives little setup detail; one community user found it hard to get CloudSQL data in and used a third-party tool. Missing for 10: an enumerated catalog of SaaS app connectors, documented partner/third-party ETL/ELT connectors, a list of supported database sources with step-by-step setup docs, and independent corroboration of connector breadth.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, first-party and partner connectors cover my sources — SaaS apps, databases, and ETL/ELT tools — with documented setup

citations.quote: With the BigQuery Data Transfer Service, to automate data loading pipelines into BigQuery, you can schedule load jobs.
This method enables replicating data from databases to BigQuery in near real time.
To stream data into BigQuery, you can use a BigQuery subscription in Pub/Sub.
Dataform lets you manage data transformation in the Extraction, Loading, and Transformation (ELT) process for data integration.
